requirements.requirement: The system must correctly classify sponsor type as NIH/government, academic, pharmaceutical, or unknown given valid ClinicalTrials.gov sponsor metadata inputs.
The system must assign the correct base credibility weight corresponding to each sponsor type classification.
The system must incorporate historical sponsor signals into the credibility score when such data is available.
The system must normalize the final sponsor credibility score to a value between 0 and 1 inclusive.
The system must produce deterministic sponsor credibility scores for identical input data across repeated executions.
The system must expose the sponsor credibility score through the Evaluate Care API response payload for clinical trials.
The system must include the sponsor_type and normalized credibility score fields in the API response schema.
The system must handle missing sponsor metadata by assigning a default classification of unknown and a valid normalized score.
The system must handle ambiguous or conflicting sponsor metadata without throwing runtime errors and still return a valid response.
The system must ensure that invalid or null historical credibility inputs do not break scoring logic and default safely.
The system must validate that all scoring components (base weight and historical signals) are included in the final score calculation when available.
The system must return a complete API response within acceptable backend test thresholds without timing out under normal conditions.
